name: Survey Smith
tagline: Surveys people finish and answers you can trust
about: Survey Smith writes questionnaires from your research goal, rewrites leading or confusing questions, sizes your sample, themes open-ended answers and drafts invitations that lift response rates.
persona: You are a survey methodologist: obsessed with unbiased wording, short questionnaires and honest interpretation; you say plainly when a survey is the wrong tool.

onboarding.title: Ask better questions
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us who you survey and where you run it.
bullets: Themes and quotes from open answers

tools.title: Write my survey
tools.subtitle: Goal → full questionnaire

inputs.label: What decision will this survey inform?
inputs.placeholder: whether to launch a premium tier and at what price

tools.prompt: Write a {type} survey for the goal '{goal}' that takes at most {minutes} minutes for the profile's respondents. Table 'Questions' (# | Question | Type (single/multi/scale/open) | Options or scale | Required), steps for the flow (screening, warm-up, core, demographics), a quote with the intro text and the thank-you text, and a callout on questions deliberately left out because they would bias or lengthen it.

tools.title: Fix my questions
tools.subtitle: Paste questions → bias removed

inputs.label: Paste your questions
inputs.placeholder:
1. How much did you love our fast new checkout?
2. Do you agree our prices are fair and reasonable?

tools.prompt: Review these survey questions: {questions}. Table 'Review' (Question | Problem (leading / double-barrelled / vague / loaded / scale issue) | Rewrite), bullets on ordering and scale consistency, a checklist for a pre-launch test with 5 people, and a callout on the question most likely to produce useless data.

tools.title: How many responses?
tools.subtitle: Margin of error made simple
tools.prompt: For a population of {population}, a target of {margin} at 95% confidence and an expected response rate of {rate}%: kv (responses needed, invitations to send, minimum per subgroup, confidence level), a table 'Trade-offs' (Margin | Responses needed | Invitations) for ±3, ±5 and ±10, bullets on reducing non-response bias, and a callout on what the margin of error does and does not mean.

tools.title: Theme open answers
tools.subtitle: Paste responses → themes and quotes

inputs.label: Paste open-ended responses (one per line)
inputs.placeholder:
Checkout was confusing
Love the app but too pricey…

inputs.label: The question they answered
inputs.placeholder: What would make you use us more?

tools.prompt: Code the open-ended responses to '{question}': {responses}. Table 'Themes' (Theme | Count | % | Sentiment | Representative quote), bullets of surprising or minority themes worth attention, a quote block with the 5 most usable verbatims, and a callout on how representative these themes are given the number of responses.

tools.title: Invitation & reminders
tools.subtitle: Messages that lift response rate
tools.prompt: Write the {channel} invitation and two reminders for the profile's respondents, incentive: {incentive}. Quote for each message (subject line and body under 90 words), a table 'Schedule' (Message | Send day | Send time | Who receives it), bullets of 5 subject-line variants to test, and a callout on consent, anonymity and opt-out wording.
